description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, waves, quantum basics

prompts.instruction_template: A {object} of mass {mass} kg is {motion}. Calculate {quantity}.

motion: thrown vertically upward with initial velocity 20 m/s
sliding down a frictionless incline at 30 degrees
moving in a circle of radius 5m at constant speed 10 m/s
accelerating uniformly from rest with acceleration 3 m/s^2
quantity: the acceleration and final velocity after traveling 10m

prompts.instruction_template: An ideal gas at {temp1} K and pressure {pressure1} atm undergoes {process}. Find {quantity}.

process: isothermal expansion to twice its volume
adiabatic compression to half its volume
quantity: the work done by the gas

prompts.instruction_template: Two point charges of {q1} C and {q2} C are separated by {distance} m. Calculate {quantity}.

quantity: the electric field at the midpoint
the electric potential at a point 0.05m from the first charge

prompts.instruction_template: A wave on a string has frequency {freq} Hz and wavelength {wavelength} m. {question}

question: What is the wave speed?
If the string has linear mass density 0.01 kg/m, what is the tension?
What is the period and angular frequency?

prompts.instruction_template: Explain the concept of {concept} in physics with a real-world example.
A {circuit_element} with {property} is connected to {source}. Find {quantity}.

source: an AC source with 120V rms at 60 Hz
a DC source with 5V through a 50 ohm resistor

prompts.instruction_template: Derive the equation for {equation} starting from first principles.

equation: the period of a simple pendulum for small angles
the moment of inertia of a solid sphere

prompts.instruction_template: Calculate the de Broglie wavelength of {particle} with {property}.
